title: 45-WORKS-INGESTION-AND-EQUATION-LEDGER
universal_lens: Unified framework integrating Bayesian hypothesis testing, bivariate scoring models, and calibration metrics to assess predictive accuracy across sports domains. Kinematic energy transfer and biomechanical alignment models unify athletic performance and injury risk through individualized baseline adjustments.
gsi_mapping: GSI employs Bayes factors for model comparison and ECE for calibration, enabling robust probabilistic inference over sport-specific outcomes via conformal prediction layers. Bayesian calibration of kinematic models using orthopedic biomechanics to infer player-specific compensation curves and injury probability surfaces.
gse_mapping: GSE leverages bivariate Poisson models for situational scoring dynamics and POMS-based affective states to simulate real-time decision-making under uncertainty in gameplay contexts. Situational reasoning engine uses speed transfer dynamics and pass-blocking likelihood ratios to simulate real-time tactical decisions and pocket survival probabilities.
